free_tier.stated: 1 TB SATA per slice at $3.00/TB/month, stackable up to multi-TB (32 TB ladder). 2 GB RAM, 1 core, 30 GB SSD boot per slice, 2 TB transfer.

chaining: The only quasi-repeatable discount here: LET runs 'Buy 1 Get 2 Free' on VPS/Storage VPS roughly quarterly, and the promo is claimed by replying with an order number in the thread — so it recurs on the promo calendar rather than per account. NodeSeek users also report a $2.40/mo 1 TB uncapped variant.
limits_note: No trial and no money-back guarantee — quoted: 'There is no trial period or money-back guarantee on Storage VPS hosting.' 2 TB/mo transfer is the cap that matters.
reliability_note: Operating since 1998; the most-recommended cheap 1 TB in both NodeSeek threads read. Datacenter in Secaucus NJ.
